info.title: Locoomo Merchant API
info.description:
Create and track shipments through the Locoomo pickup-station network.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…` / `sk_live_…` (server-side) or
`pk_…` (browser, Nodes and quotes only).
Every response is wrapped as `{ success, data, meta }` / `{ success: false, error }`;
branch on `error.code`. Stability: additive changes only within v1 —
tolerate unknown fields, enum values and webhook event types.

openingHours.description: Local time (Africa/Lagos), HH:mm, by day (mon … sun). A missing or empty day is closed.

acceptingParcels.description: False while the Node is full. Parcels already routed there still arrive.

vatKobo.description: VAT included in `amountKobo` (not added on top).

amountKobo.description: Null for publishable keys with "hide prices".

estimatedReadyInWorkingDays.description: From drop-off to ready for collection. An estimate, not a promise.

phone.description: Any Nigerian format; returned as E.164.

lengthCm.description: Send all three dimensions or none.

reference.description: Your id for this parcel, unique per account and mode.

externalBarcode.description: A barcode already on the parcel; hub scanners accept it.

storageFeesFrom.description: Waiting at the Node: storage is charged daily from this time (10 working days after `readyForCollectionAt`).

disposeAt.description: Disposed of at this time if still not collected (30 days after storage starts).

changed.description: True if we rerouted to another Node (the buyer was told).

deadline.description: End of the 7-working-day window, once on the shelf.

trackingUrl.description: Public tracking page (null in test mode).

sequence.description: Increases on every change; drop older webhooks.

dropDeadline.description: Drop off by this time or the shipment expires.

items.description: 1–100 shipments, same shape as `POST /shipments`. Each succeeds or fails on its own.

shipmentIds.description: 1–100 shipment ids, printed in this order.

data.description:
Event details, as in the webhook's `data` extras: `reason`,
`adjustment`, `previousOrigin`, `changed`, … (never collection codes).

receiver.description: Until collected; the buyer gets a fresh code if already shelved.

destinationNodeId.description: Only while `created`; re-quoted and the hold adjusted.

parcel.description: Only while `created`. Send the whole parcel object.

destinationNodeId.description: With `to: destination_changed`: the new Node (default: another nearby one).

disabledReason.description: Why we disabled it, if we did.

failingSince.description: First failure since the last success.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: After a secret roll, the old secret also signs until this time.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL. Redirects are not followed.

events.description: Event types to receive; omit or [] for all (including future ones).

enabled.description: Re-enable after fixing an endpoint we disabled (or pause one).

since.description: Resend every subscribed event since this time (within 30 days).

balanceKobo.description: Σ every entry. May be negative after re-pricing (plan §8.4).

heldKobo.description: Set aside for shipments not yet dropped off.

availableKobo.description: balance − held: what new shipments can use.

amountKobo.description:
What to pay, in kobo (₦1,000 to ₦10,000,000). Card fees are deducted
from what reaches the wallet.

creditedKobo.description: What reached the wallet; null until it succeeds.

authorizationUrl.description: Send the user here (Paystack's payment page).

lowBalanceThresholdKobo.description: Alert when available balance falls below this (kobo); null turns it off.

evidence.description: Up to 10 upload ids from `POST /claims/uploads` (photos, PDFs).

maxPayoutKobo.description: The most this claim can pay: the declared value, capped.

payoutKobo.description: Credited to the wallet, once approved.

amountKobo.description: Approve only. Defaults to the most the claim can pay.

storageFeesFrom.description: Storage is charged daily from here (10 working days after it was ready).

disposeAt.description: Disposed of at this time if still not collected.

nodeId.description: The Node the returns are waiting at.

reference.description: Public; Node staff look the batch up by it.

shipmentIds.description: Up to 1,000 shipments now; add more later. Each must be `created`.

reference.description: MF-XXXX-XXXX, printed on the manifest; the hub scans it.

missingShipmentIds.description: Leave these out of the truck, to see `missing`.

failureReason.description: Why the whole import stopped, when it did.

line.description: CSV line (1 = header); null for JSON imports.
